name: com.vitrail.ui
description: Game interfaces in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, drawn by your game's GPU without a browser: Firefox's CSS engine (Stylo) and Taffy layout through Blitz, QuickJS for scripts, a GPU painter in URP. Retained painting and off-thread work keep a change under 0.3 ms of the frame.

samples.description: A full-screen menu: buttons, a select box, a slider, gamepad navigation, a click back to C#.
A top bar over the game with resources bound to a C# model (data-bind), glass (backdrop-filter) and hover tooltips.
A scrolling inventory window: 300 cells, drag and drop between slots, the wheel and scrollbars.
A page on a quad in the scene (VitrailWorld) that takes clicks through a raycast.
